The difference between the central angles of the sectors representing the percentage population of villages D and F is :

Calculations:

Difference between population percent between D and F = 25% - 20% = 5%

Difference of central angle = 5over 100 × 360º = 18º

∴ The difference in the central angle of the sector representing the population percentage of villages D and F is 18**º**.
